description: Submit the driver's details for the booking in progress. Only call it after the customer has explicitly accepted the company's terms (terms_accepted must be true). Bota then shows the summary to confirm.

language.description: Language of the conversation, BCP-47 (es, en, pt-BR, fr, de, it…). Defaults to 'en'. Bota also answers in the language the customer writes.

session_id.description: Session id returned by a previous call for this company. Omit on the first call; ALWAYS pass it back on the next ones so Bota keeps the conversation (offers, selection, customer details).

name: provide_customer_details
title: Provide driver details
